# Real Gate & Garage Door

Real Gate & Garage Door repairs and installs automatic gates and garage doors for
residential and commercial properties across Los Angeles and Southern California,
including the San Fernando Valley, Westside, San Gabriel Valley, South Bay, Orange
County, Ventura County, Santa Clarita, Antelope Valley, and parts of the Central
Valley. Phone: (818) 915-5715. Hours: Sunday–Friday 7 AM–10 PM, Saturday closed,
emergency service available 24/7.

## Services

- [Gate Repair](https://realgaterepair.com/services/gate-repair): General repair for swing, sliding, and driveway gates — motors, hinges, sensors, and drive components.
- [Automatic Gate Repair](https://realgaterepair.com/services/automatic-gate-repair): Repair for automated gate operators — control boards, motors, sensors, and remotes.
- [Driveway Gate Repair](https://realgaterepair.com/services/driveway-gate-repair): Repair for residential driveway gates, swing and sliding configurations.
- [Electric Gate Repair](https://realgaterepair.com/services/electric-gate-repair): Diagnosis and repair of electric gate wiring, control boards, and motors.
- [Gate Opener Repair](https://realgaterepair.com/services/gate-opener-repair): Repair and replacement of gate operators — LiftMaster, Viking, All-O-Matic, DoorKing, and other brands.
- [Iron Gate Repair](https://realgaterepair.com/services/iron-gate-repair): Structural repair, welding, rust treatment, and hinge replacement for iron and wrought-iron gates.
- [Commercial Gate Repair](https://realgaterepair.com/services/commercial-gate-repair): Repair for commercial parking gates, security gates, and high-cycle operators.
- [Emergency Gate Repair](https://realgaterepair.com/services/emergency-gate-repair): After-hours gate repair for calls outside standard business hours.
- [Gate Installation](https://realgaterepair.com/services/gate-installation): Installation of new automatic, driveway, and iron gate systems.
- [Garage Door Repair](https://realgaterepair.com/services/garage-door-repair): General garage door repair — springs, openers, cables, and panels.
- [Garage Door Spring Repair](https://realgaterepair.com/services/garage-door-spring-repair): Replacement of torsion and extension springs.
- [Garage Door Opener Repair](https://realgaterepair.com/services/garage-door-opener-repair): Repair and replacement of garage door openers.
- [Garage Door Cable Repair](https://realgaterepair.com/services/garage-door-cable-repair): Repair and replacement of broken or frayed garage door cables.
- [Garage Door Panel Repair](https://realgaterepair.com/services/garage-door-panel-repair): Replacement of dented or damaged garage door panels.
- [Emergency Garage Door Repair](https://realgaterepair.com/services/emergency-garage-door-repair): After-hours garage door repair for calls outside standard business hours.
- [Commercial Garage Door Repair](https://realgaterepair.com/services/commercial-garage-door): Repair for commercial garage doors, roll-up doors, and commercial operators.
- [Garage Door Installation](https://realgaterepair.com/services/garage-door-installation): Installation of new residential garage doors.
